hello translator here

I originally planned to make this translating project in about 1 to 2 weeks, until I realized how fricking hot this doujin is and I decided to blitz it in about 2 days so I can masturbate to it as fast as possible (I have work and college too, so I cannot lock in to make this translation in a full day). Damn, kouji doujin is really fucking hot.

And because I decided to blitz it, a lot of steps I skipped, like I originally planned to redraw the SFX, redraw the cover, check the font size, make my credit page, and do some proofreading (my first language is not English, so it's kinda hard to do proofreading all by myself) so I used AI to do some proofreading. If there is bad English, that's all on me (but I promise the conversation is still coherent).

That's all, it's time for me to do the deed, byee
